readings: After detecting 0111110, the FSM returns to the state representing 'previous input 0' (resetting the consecutive-1 counter), so a following 1 is treated as the first 1.
After detecting 0111110, the FSM discards the 0 and remains in the state representing five consecutive 1s, so a following 1 is treated as the sixth 1.
err is asserted for exactly one cycle after the 7th consecutive 1 is received, then deasserts even if more 1s follow.
err remains asserted as long as 7 or more consecutive 1s are present (i.e., stays high until a 0 is received).
During the cycle when reset is high, outputs still reflect the current state (e.g., err may be 1 if the FSM was in the error state before the reset edge).
During the cycle when reset is high, all outputs are forced to 0 immediately (or on the next edge) regardless of the previous state.
